'''Nica Leross''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]. Following the [[Battle of Asylum]] she traveled to [[Odessen]] and joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. She was assigned to the [[Military Operations|military branch]] of the Alliance under former [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Bey'wan Aygo]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nica Leross appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion as a Sith Warrior vendor inside [[Alliance base|Odessen base]].
